prompt_text: Who is the best real estate agent in West Palm Beach FL to sell my house?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” agent for every West Palm Beach home—the right choice depends on your neighborhood, price range, and property type. Based on the available local agent listings, **Larry Mastropieri** and **Jeff Tricoli** are two reasonable agents to interview: both appear in seller-focused rankings, and Tricoli is listed with substantial recent sales activity. **Sandra Rathe** also ranks highly in one local directory.

Before choosing, ask each agent for:
- Recent **seller-side sales in your neighborhood** and your home’s price range
- Their suggested list price, with comparable sales to support it
- A written marketing plan and who will handle showings and negotiations
- Their commission and contract terms

Interview at least three agents and compare their plans—not just their review counts or ranking. Sources: [HomeLight’s West Palm Beach agent directory](https://www.homelight.com/west-palm-beach-fl/top-real-estate-agents), [FastExpert’s seller recommendations](https://www.fastexpert.com/top-real-estate-agents/west-palm-beach-fl/), and [Zillow’s local agent directory](https://www.zillow.com/professionals/real-estate-agent-reviews/west-palm-beach-fl/).
